description: Exact-source matched staged and unstaged two-GPU synthetic correctness checks. No served-model or throughput result.
method: Separate processes with adaptive attention unset, --ignored --exact --test-threads=1 --nocapture. The P2P fixtures compare final-token greedy winner and best/runner-up logits to per-token controls for one chunk and two chunks plus an eager tail. The device-arm regression switches 0, 1, 0 and compares every output against a host reference.

memory_admission.note: 8192 MiB minimum per card and at least prior service usage plus 256 MiB; a guard, not a measured rig footprint

limitations: The staging fixtures do not compare intermediate logits or the full final logit vector.
The forced 32-row stage selects segmented attention by source control flow; no device dispatch trace was collected.
The builds include the same local adaptive integration, per-device fix, and tokenizer source patch; their actual runtime difference is staging-related code.
No 128k/256k prompt, coding quality, served-model performance or production qualification is established.
